name: lookup_order
description: Look up an order by its order number and the email address on the order. Returns status, carrier, tracking number, items, delivery estimate and delivery date if delivered. Fails if the email does not match.

order_number.description: The five or six digit order number the customer gives you.

email.description: The email address on the order.

name: start_return
description: Start a return or a fault return for one item on an order. Returns the return label link, the refund method and whether shipping is free. Only call after you have confirmed the item and the reason with the customer.

item_id.description: The item id from the lookup_order result.

reason.description: Why the customer is returning the item.

notes.description: A short note from the customer, such as what happens when the stove is lit.

name: search_catalogue
description: Search the product catalogue. Returns up to five products with name, price, key specs, season rating and stock status. Use it before recommending any product.

query.description: What the customer is looking for, in their words.

name: shipping_options
description: Return the shipping options, prices and estimated delivery windows for a destination country and a list of item ids. Also says whether any item ships by freight.

name: handoff_to_human
description: Pass the conversation to a human support agent. Include a two sentence summary so the customer does not have to repeat themselves.

summary.description: Two sentences: who the customer is, what they need, and what you already tried.

priority.description: Urgent only for double charges and injuries.
